messages:
Sara (sec-eng): heads-up — after the least-priv refactor deploys to gpu-pool-1 started failing. seeing KMS decrypt errors + 403s from kube.
Kevin (infra): ugh, when did the refactor land? PR#4123?
Sara (sec-eng): yes, merged this morning. failing logs: 
```
2026-03-20T10:12:43Z kubernetes attach failed: permission denied
reason=forbidden user=system:serviceaccount:deployments:gpu-deployer namespace=deployments resource=pods verb=patch status=403
2026-03-20T10:12:44Z kms Decrypt AccessDeniedException key=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/rr/cryptoKeys/gpu-seal
```
Jenna (oncall): i'm on it, running quick check against rolebindings now
Rohit (runtime): my suspicion: the role got trimmed to read-only verbs earlier, we probably removed patch/create which the deployer needs for attaching sidecars/annotations (and KMS annotations are written during node init).
Kevin (infra): can you paste the role?
Sara (sec-eng): snippet from cluster (current):
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: gpu-deployer
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get", "list"]  # reduced by PR#4123
```
Rohit (runtime): yep that's the problem — deployer needs patch and create for the pod annotations to reach KMS flow. The KMS access denied is a secondary symptom because encrypt/decrypt annotations never landed properly.
Jenna (oncall): temporary mitigation: re-add 'patch' to role, roll out, confirm deploys succeed. i'll stand by to revert if anything weird.
Kevin (infra): i'll push a quick kustomize overlay hotfix and patch the role in prod namespace, will also open a rollback PR.
Kevin (infra): command i'll run: 
```bash
kubectl patch role gpu-deployer -n deployments --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/rules/0/verbs/-","value":"patch"}]'
```
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: INC-2026-034 — GPU deploy RBAC failure (trigger: 403 on pod patch) — assigned to eng-oncall
kms-bot: Alert: repeated Decrypt AccessDeniedException for key gpu-seal (3 failures in last 2m) — related to INC-2026-034
Sara (sec-eng): created GH issue GH#4239 to revert the verb removal and add unit test that simulates attach/annotation flow. tagging @Rohit for runtime test vectors.
Rohit (runtime): i'll add an e2e that exercises pod annotation + KMS write/read and add an integration check in CI.
Kevin (infra): hotfix applied to deployments namespace, reapplying controller -> scheduling looks normal again.
Jenna (oncall): monitoring: no new 403s in the last 3 minutes, gpu-deployer replicas healthy. i'll leave increased sampling on audit logs for 1 hour.
Sara (sec-eng): follow-ups: (1) revert PR#4123 or update with more specific rules + explicit exceptions documented; (2) add an RBAC/audit test to the infra test-suite; (3) add alert that ties KMS Decrypt failures -> RBAC misconfig when pod patch fails (reduce pager noise but improve signal).
Kevin (infra): I'll link INC-2026-034 to GH#4239 and add deploy rollback playbook steps.
Jenna (oncall): for the oncall runbook: if KMS decrypt errors + pod patch 403 observed, escalate to sec-eng and infra, apply hotfix overlay, validate audits.
Sara (sec-eng): thanks everyone. we'll do a short postmortem tomorrow and schedule the least-priv refactor follow-up. :thumbsup:
Kevin (infra): ack, i'll keep the hotfix in place until we have tests in CI and a safer PR.
Rohit (runtime): thanks — i'll push the e2e by EOD.
Jenna (oncall): closing thread for now, monitoring will update INC-2026-034 if anything regresses.
